padding: 16px 24px; }.nav-logo { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-color, #f8fafc); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }.nav-logo-img { max-height: 36px; width: auto; display: block; }.nav-menu { display: flex; align-items: center; }.nav-list { display: flex; gap: 24px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }.nav-item { position: relative; }.nav-link { color: var(--text-dim, #94a3b8); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; transition: color 0.2s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }.nav-link:hover { color: var(--text-color, #f8fafc); }.dropdown-arrow { font-size: 0.75rem; }.dropdown-menu { position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; background-color: var(--header-bg, #0f172a); min-width: 200px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 0; list-style: none; display: none; z-index: 100; }.nav-item.has-dropdown:hover .dropdown-menu { display: block; }.dropdown-link { color: var(--text-dim, #94a3b8); padding: 8px 16px; text-decoration: none; display: block; font-size: 0.9rem; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; }.dropdown-link:hover { background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: var(--text-color, #f8fafc); }.nav-cta-btn { background-color: var(--accent-color, #6366f1); color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; display: inline-block; }.nav-cta-btn:hover { opacity: 0.9; }.mobile-toggle { display: none; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; padding: 4px; }.mobile-toggle .bar { display: block; width: 24px; height: 2px; background-color: var(--text-color, #f8fafc); transition: transform 0.2s ease; }.mobile-drawer { display: none; flex-direction: column; background-color: var(--header-bg, #0f172a); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); padding: 16px 24px; }.mobile-list { list-style: none; margin: 0 0 16px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-left: 16px; margin-top: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }.mobile-sublink { color: var(--text-dim, #94a3b8); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9rem; }.mobile-cta-wrapper { padding-top: 8px; }.mobile-cta-btn { display: block; text-align: center; background-color: var(--accent-color, #6366f1); color: #ffffff; padding: 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600;
